payload.goal: State machines become Advanced Canvas drawings in the ledger (canvas frontmatter = machine identity, referenced notes = state details), compiled at load into what the engine runs; the hand-written TS machines retire; tool schemas gain the voluntary update property.
payload.load_bearing_for: Machines as TS code are invisible to the ledger: not gated, not hashed, not linkable, not owner-editable in Obsidian - violating design (section 6 authoring: canvas -> compiler, section 12 a policy IS a machine and lives in the ledger). Also: board updates arrive only when the toll pulls one, so the panel goes stale between tolls.
payload.exit_check: Engine loads session + systematic from ledger canvases (engine/machines/*.ts deleted, verify green); a drawn offer machine exists with an owner keep/discard ruling; the board renders the machine diagram from compiled data; update is a declared optional property on every tool schema and a submit carrying one refreshes the board panel; owner blesses the canvas machine form at the gate.
